evidence_reasoning: This summarizes two major theoretical frameworks from the cited literature.

claim: The proportion of place cells showing significantly different firing rates between different journeys within a given subtask was analyzed when running speed, head direction and lateral position were taken into account.
source_text: The proportion of place cells showing significantly different firing rates between different journeys within a given subtask and between different task-demands within a journey when running speed, head direction and lateral position were taken into account.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the analysis approach shown in Figure 2.

claim: The same right-to-left/left-to-right journey produces a similar neuronal trajectory at the ensemble level.
source_text: As expected from the place field properties, the same right-to-left/left-to-right journey produces a similar neuronal trajectory at the ensemble level.
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the place field analysis and trajectory classification results.

claim: The trajectories are shifted between the task-demands in certain spaces, thereby generalizing a journey over task-demands.
source_text: However, the trajectories are shifted between the task-demands in certain spaces (PC2 in this schematic), thereby generalizing a journey over task-demands.
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the rate remapping findings and trajectory analysis showing task-demand effects.

claim: When the future direction changes from the expectation at the decision point, the trajectory shifts to the corresponding one.
source_text: When the future direction changes from the expectation at the decision point, the trajectory shifts to the corresponding one (red dashed lines, VD2, VD4).
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the trajectory analysis in the VD subtask where cues can change expectations.

claim: The trajectory shift can be triggered not only by external events (the light-cues) but also by internal events (expected future direction) before the behavioral choices.
source_text: The trajectory shift can be triggered not only by external events (the light-cues) but also by internal events (expected future direction) before the behavioral choices
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the finding that trajectories diverge before behavioral choice points even in memory-guided tasks.

claim: The average accuracy for each rat was significantly higher than chance at the respective specific locations for trial type classification.
source_text: The average accuracy for each rat was significantly higher than chance at the respective specific locations.
evidence_reasoning: This is a statistical finding from the classification analysis shown in Figure 7.

claim: The central stem of the maze was the common running route among the different journeys within a given subtask.
source_text: Because the central stem of the maze was the common running route among the different journeys within a given subtask
evidence_reasoning: This describes a feature of the experimental design relevant to the analysis.

claim: The region of interest (ROI) was set at the central stem for similarity analyses.
source_text: the region of interest (ROI) was set at the region highlighted in the green shaded box.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the spatial region selected for quantitative analysis.

claim: Laps containing errors of cue interpretation were excluded from the analyses.
source_text: Laps containing errors of cue interpretation were excluded from the following analyses.
evidence_reasoning: This describes a data preprocessing step to focus on correct performance.

claim: The low rate cells (<0.1 Hz) were excluded from analysis.
source_text: The low rate cells (<0.1 Hz) were excluded.
evidence_reasoning: This describes a criterion for excluding cells with insufficient activity.

claim: Only cells identified as pyramidal were used in the analyses.
source_text: Only cells identified as pyramidal were used in the analyses outlined below.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the cell type selection criterion for analysis.

claim: The recordings were included in the data analysis if sharp wave ripple events in the LFP in the corresponding dodecatrode were identified during the immobility period.
source_text: The recordings were included in the data analysis if sharp wave ripple events in the LFP in the corresponding dodecatrode were identified during the immobility period.
evidence_reasoning: This describes a criterion for verifying proper electrode placement in CA1.

claim: The number of possible journeys in the VD subtask was twice that of the other subtasks.
source_text: The number of possible journeys in the VD subtask was twice that of the other subtasks.
evidence_reasoning: This describes a feature of the experimental design related to the VD subtask structure.

claim: 10 laps of the VD subtask were interpolated between the SA and DA subtasks to increase the sample size for the VD subtask for analysis and to clearly distinguish the behaviorally similar SA and DA subtasks.
source_text: Thus, to increase the sample size for the VD subtask for analysis, and to clearly distinguish the behaviorally similar SA and DA subtasks, 10 laps of the VD subtask were interpolated between the SA and DA subtasks.
evidence_reasoning: This explains the rationale for the specific task sequence design.

claim: The rats achieved a 95% correct decision rating from the beginning of the continuous task.
source_text: The rats achieved a 95% correct decision rating from the beginning of the continuous task.
evidence_reasoning: This reports the behavioral performance level during recording sessions.
